'''2005 Corellia Regional''' was a Star Wars CCG regional (9 January 2005). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' —
